summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of a Sales Agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC for an at-the-market offering of Class A ordinary shares. The agreement was terminated by mutual agreement on June 14, 2026. The company had sold 39,248,940 shares for gross proceeds of $30,967,191 under the agreement. This is a routine administrative termination of an equity distribution agreement, not a special situation triggering a transformative corporate event. No deal terms or strategic changes are involved.
